 Get involved Live Reporting
 Jess Anderson
 Most recent Most popular get involved Get Involved published at 17:04 GMT 17:04 GMT 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 As a Man City fan I can accept City being relegated if they have broken the rules. But I am terrified that may then save United from being relegated if they finish 18th!
 Phil, Northumberland 
 33 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Fair play to Manchester United fans they have been so up for this.
 They are willing their side on, desperate to see them get a winning result here.
 5 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 31 mins 31 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Man Utd have lost 21 of their last 22 Premier League matches when trailing by 2+ goals (D1) - their last victory was against Aston Villa at Old Trafford on Boxing Day 2023 (won 3-2).
 279 139 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 30 mins 30 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Manchester United are well on top at the moment and have been pretty much peppering the opposition goal.
 But that nightmare start is so far proving costly.
 364 175 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 29 mins 29 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Bruno Fernandes steals in and tests Zion Suzuki at his near post but the keeper gets down to make a good save.
 Seconds later the ball comes to Amad 10-yards out and it takes a deflection off Pau Torres before dragging wide of the post.
 Suddenly Villa's defence and keeper are very busy.
 263 170 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Man Utd correctly awarded penalty' published at 16:59 GMT 16:59 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Darren Cann 
Former Premier League assistant referee on BBC Sport 
 Manchester United were correctly awarded a penalty for a foul on Matheus Cunha. It was an excellent piece of refereeing to correctly spot that Boubacar Kamara made foul contact with Cunha before playing the ball.
 463 866 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'United are working nicely' published at 16:59 GMT 16:59 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Good move from Man United. They're working nicely across the pitch. 
 It comes to Bruno Fernandes, half decent strike and that could have gone anywhere. 
 202 299 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 28 mins 28 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Manchester United knocking on the door.
 Zion Suzuki deals with back-to-back corners before another wicked deflection from Kobbie Mainoo's effort almost catches the keeper out but he saves under his post.
 167 153 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 27 mins 27 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Manchester United so close to an equaliser after Bruno Fernandes' shot from just inside the 18-yard box takes a big deflection off John McGinn and that could have gone anywhere.
 Luckily for Villa, it drops wide of the post for a corner.
 333 258 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 16:57 GMT 16:57 GMT 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 Three certainty's in life. Death, taxes and penalty to United.
 Jockney, Manchester 
 1876 585 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Zion Suzuki takes no chances on the corner and dives on the ball to smother it.
 191 71 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 25 mins 25 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Matheus Cunha goes for goal from just outside the area and he forces Zion Suzuki into a really good diving save.
 It needed saving so it will be a corner for Manchester United.
 359 179 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 23 mins 23 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Ian Maatsen goes down clutching his head but there's nothing in that.
 Things have settled down after a full-throttle start.
 142 124 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The goal will give them confidence' published at 16:52 GMT 16:52 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Once Man United have got into the Villa half they've created some nice passages of play, some good combinations from Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes and Bryan Mbeumo. That goal will give them confidence. 
 488 897 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 16:51 GMT 16:51 GMT 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 A serious reality check here. Utd are in trouble, and in the relegation fight. With these players, I can see them actually going down.
 John, Lincoln 
 2393 507 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 13 goals conceded in four and a bit games by Man Utd published at 16:50 GMT 16:50 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Simon Stone 
BBC Sport Chief Football News Reporter at Old Trafford 
 There are many things wrong with Manchester United at present but this statistic says a lot.
 Since the start of their Champions League game at Como, Michael Carrick's side have conceded 13 goals in 380 minutes.
 That's one in a little under half an hour. You won't get anywhere doing that.
 856 171 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Fernandes was calm' published at 16:49 GMT 16:49 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Andy Reid 
Former Republic of Ireland midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 A fantastic pen, Bruno Fernandes watches the keeper all the way. 
 He was really calm and composed. Really well taken, this has the makings of a really good game. 
 554 981 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18 mins 18 mins 
 Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa 
 Bit of deja vu here - will a Bruno Fernandes penalty spark the same comeback as it did against Roma on Tuesday?
 The crowd have got their tails up now. They are desperate to see their side win.
 367 807 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Man Utd 1-2 Aston Villa published at 16:47 GMT 16:47 GMT 
 Bruno Fernandes (16 mins, pen) 
 Calmly slotted into the bottom corner by Bruno Fernandes as Zion Suzuki goes the wrong way.
 The Manchester United captain grabs the ball out of the back of the net.
 Game on?
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1891 4323 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16 mins 16 mins 
 Man Utd 0-2 Aston Villa 
 It isn't. Manchester United have the chance to half the deficit.
 Just as did were against Roma in midweek, Manchester United have the chance to get back into this game with a penalty.
 468 1119 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing
